_roleMismatchNote.description: Free-text note explaining the roleMismatch / roleMismatchBody split.

sponsorshipDenial.description: Phrases that indicate sponsorship will not be provided. Any match discards the job. Matched IN ADDITION to the generic negation-aware detector in utils/sponsorshipLanguage.js, which catches refusal constructions no fixed list can enumerate.

roleMismatch.description: Phrases indicating the role does not match the target profile. Matched against the TITLE (plus employmentType) only, since a role's identity is stated in its title -- matching them against the JD body made senior roles disqualify themselves for saying 'mentor junior engineers'.

roleMismatchBody.description: Role-mismatch phrases that are genuine statements about scope in the JD body ('frontend only') and so are matched against the FULL text rather than the title.

employmentMismatch.description: Phrases indicating an unacceptable employment arrangement.

geography.description: Optional US-only location gate. Discards jobs whose location field names a non-US country/city with no US signal.

clearanceAllowance.description: Phrases that, if present, keep a clearance-tagged role (e.g. explicitly open to visa holders).

employmentTypes.description: Config-driven markers for Full-time vs Contract categorization (does not discard; see employmentMismatch for exclusions).

_generatedFrom.description: Set when the seniority and geography rules here were derived from the active search profile.

roleMismatchDerived.description: Seniority exclusions derived from the active profile's DESIRED level. Kept separate from the hand-written roleMismatch list so activating a different profile never silently edits the user's own rules. A candidate targeting entry level gets an EMPTY list here, where the shipped file hardcoded "junior"/"entry level"/"intern".
